subject: Subprocessor addition: LogStream — DPA & Order Form flow-down
messages:
From: Marco Ruiz <mruiz@evercloud.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Jenn Park <jenn.park@evercloud.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Notice: Subprocessor addition — LogStream (analytics vendor)

Hi Lauren,

Per Section 6.2 of our MSA, I’m sending formal notice that EverCloud intends to add LogStream (subprocessor) to the chain for log aggregation and metrics ingestion for the EverCloud-managed integration. We are attaching the subprocessor notice and the most recent SOC2 type II summary for LogStream for your review (evercloud_subproc_notice.pdf).

Key facts:
- Subprocessor: LogStream, Inc. (logstream.com)
- Purpose: logging/metric ingestion only (no PII in plaintext; logs are hashed at ingestion)
- Effective date: target 2027-09-01
- Requested flow-down: standard DPA + 30-day right-to-audit clause; order form amendment to reflect allowed cascade

Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept this as-is, or whether you need an Order Form addendum and DPA amendment? We’re happy to start an expedited DocuSign flow if needed.

Thanks,
Marco Ruiz
Head of Partnerships — EverCloud
marco.ruiz@evercloud.com

Attachments: evercloud_subproc_notice.pdf (PDF; 112 KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <mruiz@evercloud.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 15:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Subprocessor addition — LogStream (analytics vendor)

Kimberly / Jordan — looping you both in.

Summary of ask from EverCloud: they want to add LogStream for logs, effective ~Sep 1. They propose a DPA flow-down and Order Form amendment. Marco attached the SOC2 summary.

Please advise:
1) Legal: can we accept the subproc with standard MSA+DPA flow-down, or do we require specific vendor controls language / retention carveouts?
2) Procurement/Contracts: do we need an Order Form amendment (they say yes) and is there commercial impact we should track on HC-8921?

I’ve attached our internal subprocessor checklist and the current Order Form snapshot (orderform_amendment_draft.pdf) — please review and send back redlines by EOD Tue so we can give EverCloud a firm answer. If we need a DocuSign path, I’ll kick it off once we have redlines.

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <mruiz@evercloud.com>, Jenn Park <jenn.park@evercloud.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Subprocessor addition — LogStream (analytics vendor)

Thanks Lauren — quick read through and initial position below. I’m attaching a redline (msaredline_v3.docx) with suggested wording; highlights:

- Approve with conditions: we can accept LogStream provided EverCloud executes an Order Form amendment to include the subprocessor and a DPA addendum that includes (i) the same security obligations we flow to customers, (ii) a 30-day remediation window, and (iii) a 30-day advance notice on changes to how logs are retained/processed.
- Add explicit encryption-in-transit and at-rest callouts for logs, and require LogStream to provide the full SOC2 report under NDA (not just the summary) prior to onboarding.
- We should add a 30-day audit-rights clause limited to verification of controls relevant to log handling (scope: LogStream ingestion pipeline).
- Minor commercial ask: if LogStream will persist any derived telemetry outside EverCloud’s tenancy, request a modest order form fee (tracked against HC-8921) — Jordan, happy for you to sign off on exact language.

If EverCloud cannot provide the full SOC2 report or accept the audit clause, we should push for a compensating control (e.g., attested encryption key management).

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Subprocessor addition — LogStream (analytics vendor)

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Position and next steps (Redwood legal + contracts):
1) Conditional approval: Redwood will accept LogStream as a subprocessor on the conditions Kimberly outlined. Specifically we need:
   - Executed Order Form amendment reflecting the subprocessor and any additional fees (if applicable)
   - DPA addendum signed by EverCloud and LogStream that includes the 30-day audit clause and encryption language
   - LogStream SOC2 full report provided under NDA (we can sign a mutual NDA if required)
2) If EverCloud can supply the SOC2 report and sign the DPA addendum we’ll queue the DocuSign package. Link (provisional): https://docusign.com/project/EV-4521-LOGSTREAM
3) Commercial: Procurement will track any order-form fee under deal HC-8921; please confirm whether EverCloud intends to pass through a charge.

Marco / Jenn — can you confirm: (A) will you provide the full SOC2 report under NDA by Aug 10, and (B) do you accept the audit-rights scope limited to log ingestion? If yes, we’ll circulate the redline, lock the Order Form amendment, and start DocuSign.
